row.body: A master key lies across a folded departure notice; the hall door was logged locked before the bus left, though a margin says it stood open. The custodian has underlined “return key” twice.
row.title: The key return

sidecar.gloss: A hall key and departure record disagree about whether the building was secured before transport left.
sidecar.rival_reading: A program crew could have used the hall and its transport during ordinary field work; the contradictory door note does not say why the bus left.

row.body: the folded tarp and bath towel are wedged beneath unused warning tape. footprints pass around the bundle rather than toward it.
row.title: missing count beside the folded tarp

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

row.body: The caretaker says the grounds crew borrowed the kitchen sink for a rinse. Please keep the side room locked until the treated beds are dry; the folding chairs are still needed tomorrow.
row.title: Before the beds dry

sidecar.gloss: A caretaker's request links a grounds crew, rinsed equipment, and a temporary room restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response crew could have rinsed equipment and restricted access after an emergency; the note never identifies what treatment reached the grounds.
